days.heading: Myrtos reveal, then Assos harbor

facts.label: Swim
facts.valueHtml: Myrtos is a wade/photo stop; Assos is the calmer option

days.note: The home-card day: cliffs first, harbor lunch second.

spots.name: Myrtos cliff-road reveal, then Assos harbor
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: Myrtos Beach's white crescent and deep blue bay seen from the cliff road above, Kefalonia
A lone swimmer where turquoise shallows meet deep blue water at Myrtos Beach, Kefalonia

spots.cost: Myrtos viewpoints and Assos wandering are free; budget sunbeds/parking only if used. Myrtos’s steep shelf and changing swell make it a look/wade beach for the younger child, not the primary swim.
spots.climate: June is warm and dry on Kefalonia: plan around roughly 78–84°F air and 72–74°F sea as historical proxies. Mornings are likelier to be calmer; west-facing exposure can build later.
spots.saveHtml: Save Lead with the free cliff-road photo and have lunch in Assos rather than renting Myrtos sunbeds all day.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Assos harbor lunch at a waterside taverna after the viewpoint.
spots.restoHtml:
• Platanos, Assos — pizza, pasta and grilled options.
  • Nefeli-Anait, Assos — simple taverna dishes and fries.
  • Sami groceries — pack water and beach food.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Assos harbor swim if Myrtos surf is up.
  • Skip the beach descent if parking/heat makes the cliff view enough.

days.heading: Melissani + Drogarati, timed for the light

facts.label: Tickets
facts.valueHtml: Current combined cave pricing is a proxy; recheck 2027

spots.name: Melissani lake at midday light + Drogarati cave
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: Melissani Cave's collapsed roof lighting the underground lake electric turquoise at midday, Kefalonia
A wooden tour boat crossing Melissani Cave's glowing blue-green underground lake, Kefalonia
Rowboats crossing Melissani Cave's turquoise underground lake beneath the collapsed round roof opening, Kefalonia

spots.cost: Current Sami Municipality pricing lists Melissani at €10 adult / €5 reduced and Drogarati at €6 adult / €3 reduced, with a €4 Drogarati ticket after a Melissani ticket; current daily hours are 09:00–18:00. Recheck 2027 prices and the exact family eligibility.
spots.climate: This is the midday exception: Melissani’s overhead light is the payoff, while Drogarati is cool and a useful heat break. Expect queues around the cave boats.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use the current combined-ticket discount and bring your own lunch for Antisamos afterward.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private transfer/guide only if avoiding parking and timing stress is worth it.
spots.restoHtml:
• Contessina, Sami — pizza, pasta and harbor seating.
  • Tereza, Sami — pizza/café fallback.
  • Karavomylos picnic — keeps the caves schedule flexible.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Antisamos first if cruise/coach congestion makes the cave queues unpleasant.
  • Do one cave rather than rushing both with tired kids.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Sami Municipality: Melissani & Drogarati

spots.name: Fiskardo harbor: northern Kefalonia at a deliberately slow pace
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: A sailing yacht anchored in a turquoise cove near Fiskardo, Kefalonia
Yachts moored in Fiskardo harbor with pastel Venetian houses lining the waterfront, Kefalonia
Colorful Venetian-style waterfront houses and a moored fishing boat in Fiskardo village, Kefalonia

spots.cost: Harbor wandering is free; this is a longer north-island drive, so the cost is fuel and a scenic lunch rather than admission.
spots.climate: Use the calm morning for the longer drive. The harbor is a towns-and-food counterweight to beach days, with a swim stop only if the family wants one.
spots.saveHtml: Save Keep this one harbor meal and use a picnic / apartment dinner for the second meal.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A waterfront lunch with adults’ seafood and a pizza/pasta fallback for kids.
spots.restoHtml:
• Irida’s, Fiskardo — pizza, pasta and harbor tables.
  • Apagio, Fiskardo — grilled chicken/fish and fries.
  • Sami bakery stop — trail snacks for the drive.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Pair with Assos only if everyone is comfortable with the longer scenic day.
  • Stay near Sami for a low-output beach day if jet lag lingers.

days.heading: Antisamos: the calm-swim reset

facts.label: Sea
facts.valueHtml: Historical June proxy 72–74°F; daily flags win

days.note: A true beach day before the boat.

spots.name: Antisamos: the easy, green-backed family swim day
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: Antisamos Beach's turquoise water and white pebble shore backed by green pine-covered mountains, Kefalonia
Sailboats anchored below the green mountain backdrop of Antisamos Beach, Kefalonia
Antisamos Beach's turquoise-to-navy water framed by steep pine-green mountains, Kefalonia

spots.cost: Beach access is free; budget optional sunbeds, snacks and fuel. This is the scheduled easy swim day rather than a decorative beach stop.
spots.climate: Historical June sea temperature is about 72–74°F. Antisamos is a more manageable swim choice than Myrtos, but real wind, flags and sea state still win on the day.
spots.saveHtml: Save Bring shade/snacks and use the free beach rather than a beach-club package.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Rent two sunbeds/umbrella for the all-day reset.
spots.restoHtml:
• Antisamos beach café — sandwiches, fries and simple beach food.
  • Tereza, Sami — pizza at the end of the day.
  • AB / Lidl, Argostoli — full grocery reset if needed.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Karavomylos waterfront for a calmer, shorter swim.
  • Indoor cave timing if a hot afternoon needs shade.

days.heading: Zakynthos boat: Navagio water-view + Blue Caves

facts.label: Constraint
facts.valueHtml: Navagio landing is unconfirmed/likely restricted; do not promise it

days.note: Book only after 2027 access and sea-state terms are clear.

spots.name: Zakynthos day boat: Navagio viewpoint-from-water + Blue Caves
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: Aerial view of Navagio Shipwreck Beach's rusted wreck on white sand in a turquoise cove ringed by pale cliffs, Zakynthos
Cliff-top aerial of Navagio Beach's shipwreck and turquoise cove with tour boats crossing the electric-blue water, Zakynthos

spots.cost: Budget a pre-booked full-day boat from Kefalonia. Navagio landing/swimming has been closed under a 2026 landslide safety decision; treat any 2027 cove access as unknown until the operator and authority confirm it. The honest plan is water viewing plus Blue Caves.
spots.climate: Early sea is smoother. This is a motion-sickness and wind-sensitive day; choose a licensed operator with cancellation/refund terms and make Antisamos the no-boat fallback.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book a standard shared boat with a clear Navagio-closure policy rather than paying for a promised landing that may be illegal.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Small-group boat with shade, swim ladder and hotel transfer.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pack sandwiches — boat-day food is usually expensive and limited.
  • Sami pizza — simple recovery dinner after the water.
  • Argostoli bakery — use it for a shore-day fallback picnic.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Antisamos + Sami if weather cancels the boat.
  • Blue Caves only if Navagio restrictions remove the full-day value.

days.heading: Argostoli turtles + Lassi warm-water finale

facts.label: Wildlife
facts.valueHtml: Look, never approach or feed turtles

days.note: Use the final Kefalonia day for Argostoli turtles and a Lassi swim; keep the evening flexible around the eventual outbound schedule.

spots.name: Argostoli loggerhead-turtle harbor walk + Lassi/Makris Gialos
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr
spots.cost: The harbor walk and beach are free; budget beach chairs, a final meal and airport-adjacent fuel. Wildlife sightings are not guaranteed and must stay at a respectful distance.
spots.climate: Use this as the warm-water finish. Lassi offers a simpler, shallower beach option near the airport than Myrtos. Follow current beach flags and never approach turtles.
spots.saveHtml: Save Stay/park near Argostoli or Lassi for the final night so the airport morning is easy.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge One final sunset dinner in Argostoli after a short Lassi swim.
spots.restoHtml:
• Il Borgo, Argostoli — pizza, pasta and relaxed final-night seating.
  • Libretto, Argostoli — burgers, pasta and fries.
  • Lassi bakeries — airport-morning breakfast.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Repeat Antisamos if the family prefers the greener beach.
  • Harbor-only morning if wildlife etiquette or heat makes a beach day feel wrong.
